/bin/bash -lc "/opt/conda/bin/pvpython - <<'PY'
from paraview.simple import *
import glob,re
fs=sorted(glob.glob('/workspace/Ionization/*.vti'),key=lambda p:int(re.search(r'(\\d+)',p).group(1)))
r=XMLImageDataReader(FileName=fs)
s=TTKTopologicalSimplificationByPersistence(Input=r);s.PersistenceThreshold=0.1;s.ThresholdIsAbsolute=1;s.InputArray=['POINTS','Scalars_']
UpdatePipeline(time=0,proxy=s)
print('simp class ports',s.GetNumberOfOutputPorts())
for i in range(s.GetNumberOfOutputPorts()):
 print(i,s.GetOutputPort(i).GetDataInformation().GetDataSetTypeAsString(),s.GetOutputPort(i).GetDataInformation().GetPointDataInformation().GetNumberOfArrays())
c=TTKContourTree(Input=s);c.ScalarField=['POINTS','Scalars_']
UpdatePipeline(time=0,proxy=c)
print('tree ports',c.GetNumberOfOutputPorts())
for i in range(c.GetNumberOfOutputPorts()):
 info=c.GetOutputPort(i).GetDataInformation()
 print('port',i,info.GetDataSetTypeAsString(),'points',info.GetNumberOfPoints(),'cells',info.GetNumberOfCells())
 p=info.GetPointDataInformation(); print(' point arrays',[p.GetArrayInformation(j).GetName() for j in range(p.GetNumberOfArrays())])
 q=info.GetCellDataInformation(); print(' cell arrays',[q.GetArrayInformation(j).GetName() for j in range(q.GetNumberOfArrays())])
PY"

Completed the ParaView/TTK workflow for all 21 Ionization time steps.

Outputs:

- [Original viridis scalar-field render](/workspace/Ionization_renderings/ionization_original_viridis.png)
- [Simplified piecewise-linear contour tree render](/workspace/Ionization_renderings/ionization_simplified_contour_tree.png)
- [Editable ParaView state](/workspace/Ionization_renderings/ionization_contour_tree.pvsm)
- [Reproduction script](/workspace/render_ionization.py)

The contour tree uses absolute persistence simplification `0.1`, radius-2 critical-point glyphs (maxima red, 2-saddles orange, 1-saddles white, minima blue), and line width 1 for arcs.
